title: Tom's Structures (Dp Edition)
description:
This datapack adds new structures  to you Minecraft World :)
have fun by looting the structures
body:
- This datapack adds new structures with unique loot to your world. Discover exciting, cozy, and interesting structures and have fun looting!
- Currently, the datapack only supports the overworld, but nether structures and end structures will be added in updates.
- **Some structures contain items that were only added in later versions; for example, if you are using this mod in a version prior to 1.21.9 (i.e., 1.21.8 or older), all chests containing copper tools in your world will be empty.**

# requirements
- This datapack requires "Tom's Loot" to start.
- The probabilities of items in chests **can vary** depending on the **[version of "Tom's Loot"](https://modrinth.com/datapack/toms-loot-dpe/versions)**. Please pay **attention to [changes](https://modrinth.com/datapack/toms-loot-dpe/changelog)** in the loot tables of **"Tom's Loot"**.

# alternative:
If you like, you're welcome to use the more [extensive mod version](https://modrinth.com/mod/toms-structures);

I deliberately didn't upload the datapack alongside the mod so that the mod would appear under "mods" rather than "datapacks"—since it can't be in both categories simultaneously, separating them ensures it shows up in both.
